title: respond_to_clarification
description: Resolve a clarification previously emitted by another tool. Used only when the client does not support MCP elicitation. The server re-runs the original tool call with the author's answer merged into the originating args.

answer.description: MUST match one of valid_answers if that list was enumerated; otherwise free text allowed per the originating ClarificationRequest.

output_ok.description: Returns the original tool's output_ok payload (shape varies by originating_tool).

output_clarification.description: If the answer itself triggers a further clarification (e.g., a suggested fallback still conflicts), another ClarificationRequest may chain.

clarification_triggers: unknown clarification_id (expired or from another session): return error, no chain
answer not in valid_answers AND free_text_allowed=false: ask again with same id
